calibration: sigmoid (Platt scaling) on a frozen/prefit GaussianNB
baseline: constant probability equal to training positive-class frequency
threshold_selection: predefined; not tuned on test results
noise_model: X_test + scale * train_feature_std * Z, Z ~ N(0,1) iid

corruption_rng.stream_key_meaning: ASCII SHIF; independent of sklearn RNGs

noise_reuse: one standard-normal array per seed, reused across scales
model_policy: fit once on train/calib; freeze across corruption conditions
matched_coverage_note: Retrospective diagnostic: rank already-scored test rows by confidence, breaking ties by original dataset row index. Not a deployment-ready threshold.
